name: @quarry/data-connection-microservice
description: The Data Connection service (docs/design/architecture-split.md, phase 2): sources, syncs and their runs, in a process of its own, on its own database login. Datasets through Catalog's microservice calls, credentials through Keychain's. Browsers reach it through the main server.

scripts.dev: nodemon -w src -w ../../../platform/kernel -w ../../../libraries/shared -w ../../../libraries/integrations -e ts,json --exec ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/main.ts
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
